claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Acetyl-farnesyl-cysteine is a competitive inhibitor of isoprenylcysteine carboxyl methyltransferase (ICMT) that blocks carboxyl methylation of prenylated proteins such as lamin-B and Rac1, but at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity because ICMT inhibition is cytostatic rather than acutely lethal in most cancer lines.
